question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who cannot hear.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Deaf**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Deaf**'.
 
• "**Deaf** [बहरा (Bahra)]" specifically refers to someone who has a partial or complete inability to hear. It's a medically recognized term to describe the inability to perceive sound.
 
 
• *Example: The concert had sign language interpreters to cater to the needs of the **deaf** attendees.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Deaf.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Illegible** - Unable to be read or deciphered; in Hindi: अपठित (Apathit)
 
• **Inaudible** - Unable to be heard; in Hindi: अनसुना (Anasuna)
 
• **Dumb** - Lacking the power of speech; in the context of this question, it might be considered offensive; in Hindi: गूंगा (Goonga)
